long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Milan to the family behind Loro Piana, Pier Luigi studied economics before joining the textile company. He and his brother Sergio later took the reins, broadening a specialist wool and cashmere producer into luxury goods and building an international retail arm. That operating record makes him an active inheritor who expanded the business, rather than a passive beneficiary.

LVMH subsequently bought a controlling interest in Loro Piana, while official transaction records documented Pier Luigi as a minority shareholder without decisive control. He continued as deputy chairman, linking the founding family to the company after the sale. His wealth is therefore tied to a family stake and the value created during his leadership. The company's stores, production sites, revenues and other corporate assets belong to Loro Piana, not to him personally.
